items.title: DeepSeek announces open-sourcing inference framework DeepInfer to reduce compute costs, energy consumption
[AINews] DeepSeek DeepInfer: Open Source SOTA Inference running 155T toks/day/cluster making $22m/day at ~80% margin for a 81 day payback
DeepSeek open-sources the inference engine behind its API. And Huawei gets equal billing with Nvidia.
DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer, the engine that runs its AI models
DeepSeek makes DeepInfer open source to cut AI costs
